InfoItems.Info: Fixture has On Off switch on base of fixture Ch 6 - Lamp needs 5 minutes to cool after switching off. Lamp will not switch on within this time, but any lamp on command will be saved and execued when the time is over. Ch 6 DMX 230-239 - Select Lamp Off via DMX to enable Lamp Off control via DMX Weight for fixture with electromagnetic ballast.
